carried_set_rule: One carried model, lstm-instantaneous (configs/phase3/a/instantaneous.json), carried to test if and only if the validation rule holds; nothing else is trained or gated.
change: phase 3 (SRD Annex B, spec 010): generator 0.4.0 (one target course change in 80% of scenarios); the iteration-4 instantaneous LSTM configuration trained from scratch on it (seed 208); G4 against the frozen reference tracker
rationale: G3 passed for the hybrid; the network alone is about 3 x classical on held-course targets. Phase 3 tests the one place a learned estimator has an in-principle advantage: after a target turn. Research (experiments/20261028-p3-research): R1 turns show in bearings a median 130 s after they end; R2 the better tuned-turn tracker on validation is the IMM (13.6% median range error at manoeuvre + 300 s; EKF 15.3%); R3 the untrained iteration-4 LSTM is 1.92 x the reference on range and 2.21 x on course. Forecast recorded before training: G4-range ratio central 1.0 (0.75-1.3), G4-course 0.85 (0.6-1.2), P(pass) about 30%. Validation rule (FR-007): carry to test only if G4-range and G4-course points are below 1 with intervals not wholly at or above 1, and G4-control passes.
